children.name: Batis argillicola Royen
children.description: Batis argillicola is a species of flowering plant in the family Bataceae, native to southern New Guinea and northern Australia.

children.name: Batis maritima L.
children.description: Batis maritima, the saltwort or beachwort (also known as turtleweed, pickleweed, barilla, planta de sal, camphire, herbe-à-crâbes, and akulikuli-kai ), is a halophyte.
